about:
hey, I'm Mehh and/or Zack … . I made this page to be part resume, part hacker notebook, part just a place for me to put my "me" stuff. 
A couple things to highlight, I've been teaching Cyber Security 1 on 1 for some time now and I'll be moving any content I've made for that over into classes, FYI it will be provided in both English and Ukrainian. So feel free to check that out. 
And I also, whenever I have free time dabble in creative writing projects, music, and other stuff that can be found in Personal. 
Okay have fun.
whoMeet: Cybersecurity homies, creative writing homies, I dunno, if you’re a human that does cool stuff hmu.

pageIntros.lab: Dare I call this a lab, this is where I’ll be dropping stuff that I work on. Who knows.
pageIntros.classes: Classes! Okay so classes started from an idea I had where I was teaching someone cyber security 1 on 1, and found that I had content and ideas and I figured I’d share some of that here. Also for funzies, some if it will be in Ukrainian.
pageIntros.personal: The non-professional corner. Music, writing, cars, whatever else doesn't belong on a resume. Pick a tag below or just scroll.
